description: This file defines a specialized VAD (Voice Activity Detection) analyzer class named AICVADAnalyzer that integrates with the AIC SDK backend to perform voice activity detection. It includes initialization, parameter handling, backend binding, and inference logic for speech detection in audio streams.

classes.name: AICVADAnalyzer
classes.description: A VAD analyzer class that lazily instantiates an AIC SDK VAD backend, manages VAD parameters, and provides speech confidence estimates based on the backend's boolean detection.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, vad_factory: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None, lookback_buffer_size: Optional[float] = None, sensitivity: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the AICVADAnalyzer with optional custom VAD factory, lookback buffer size, and sensitivity parameters.

methods.name: bind_vad_factory(self, vad_factory: Callable[[], Any])
methods.description: Attaches or replaces the VAD factory function post-construction and attempts to initialize the backend.

methods.name: _apply_backend_params(self)
methods.description: Applies optional VAD parameters (lookback buffer size and sensitivity) to the backend if available.

methods.name: _ensure_backend_initialized(self)
methods.description: Initializes the backend VAD by invoking the factory if not already set, and applies parameters.

methods.name: set_sample_rate(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing and ensures backend initialization.

methods.name: int num_frames_required(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames required for processing based on a 10 ms window.

methods.name: float voice_confidence(self, buffer: bytes)
methods.description: Computes and returns a confidence score (0.0 or 1.0) indicating presence of speech detected by the backend.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, vad_factory: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None, lookback_buffer_size: Optional[float] = None, sensitivity: Optional[float] = None, )
